This '''Mandalorian''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] on an unidentified [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalorian space]].

==Biography==
The [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] had claimed [[HK-47]], who had completed an [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] mission for [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] but was damaged and unable to return to his master, as his 'booty'. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] repaired HK-47 (rather poorly, the droid mentioned) to the extent he was capable of and began using his assassination protocol to raise his rank.

Eventually the soldier's desire for power soon got the better of him. He then ordered HK to assassinate an [[Unidentified Mandalore|unidentified]] [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] who ruled between [[Mandalore the Ultimate]] and [[Canderous Ordo|Mandalore the Preserver]]. He failed and was captured by the Mandalore, who reprogrammed him and sent him after his former master, who was successfully [[Death/Legends|obliterated]]. Since HK-47 was programmed to shut down whenever his current master died, he deactivated himself after killing the Mandalorian, and was sold to [[Bochaba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sleheyron/Legends|Sleheyron]].
